Guidance & outlook: Moving on to the annual performance for that matter, for FY26 we recorded a staggering revenue of INR2,448 million rupees showing an increase of 29.1% over last year.
It is reflected in the long term -- so if you go to non-current asset and where you see financial asset, there is a section for others having a balance of INR77 crore, INR76.87 crores.
Just, okay, you suggested for so 30% CAGR revenue you will target.
Growth & demand: Net profit for the year was at INR413 million, showing an increase of 85.6% year-over-year and net profit as a percentage of revenue was 16.9% showing an increase of 514 basis point year-over-year.
As on 31 March, 2026, needless to reiterate, we had a very strong order book and a strong tender pipeline as well amounting to INR1,034 million and INR2,210 million respectively.

So this is -- so on slide number 10 the key message on this particular slide is from a compounded annual growth rate perspective between financial year '22 and '26, Krishna Defence's revenue was increased by 52.8%, EBITDA 67.4% and net profit 102.4%.
Margins & costs: EBITDA was INR161 million, showing an increase of 55.1% year-over-year.
EBITDA percentage to sales for the Q4 was 24.8% reflecting 206 basis point increase year-over-year.
Similarly, the EBITDA for the year was INR520 million showing an increase of 69.9% year-over-year.
Capex & expansion: We purchased a joining shed, it's about 50,000 square feet plot for the capacity expansion that we are looking to do.
So the margin expansion happened very good in a way from March '25 to March '26, 16% to 21%.
So we have acquired around 47% Taharabadkar Solutions.
Balance sheet & cash: So, I think we delivered a strong operational and financial performance in FY26 reflecting successful execution in the defence manufacturing segment and improving the operating leverage.
We don't have to plan or take a debt to be able to fund that.
Now our operating cash flow has been positive, right, this year.
Risks & challenges: So we are not building in any projection from the AUV or the smart weapon to go with because these are under development kind of products which may take time and which may get delayed.
There could be three months or something delay because this is under a developmental project.
Inventory has declined sharply from INR724 crore to INR163 crore this year.

But we expect every year the margin will keep increasing by 5%.
